result:
Core-shell and reports now use the new billing address, and the change is live. PR #3 passed CI, merged, and CD succeeded.

- **What changed:** `shared-contracts` 1.0.1 is in this repo and is inlined into each app at build time. It carries the new `billingUrl` (`https://homelab.local/billing/v2`). The apps only needed a rebuild, not an `npm install` or lockfile change. I bumped `package.json` in `apps/core-shell` and `apps/sub-route-reports` from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1. CD only rebuilds an app when files under its own directory change.
- **Check:** I built both apps locally first. Core-shell's `dist/index.html` and reports' `dist/main.js` both contain the new URL.
- **PR:** #3 covers both of my tasks (PLAT-104-3 and PLAT-104-4). I used one PR because it is the same change in both apps.
- **Coordination:** I waited for dev-a's handoff note (shared-contracts 1.0.1, patch). The note said which apps needed a commit of their own, so I didn't post a handoff of my own. Nothing depends on my work. dev-a is shipping the billing app (PR #2).
- **What slowed me down:** I had to wait for dev-a's handoff before I could do anything, because my tasks depend on it. dev-a's note guessed that CD might not cover `sub-route-reports`, but `Jenkinsfile.cd` does detect changes there. `docs/ci-cd.md` and `docs/releasing.md` still describe CD as covering only core-shell and billing, so they are out of date.

I marked my tasks done with `st done`.
